visual_logic.surface_detail: Durable, fine-grained scales with a 'counter-shaded' palette: slate-grey dorsal surface with subtle dappled light patterns, transitioning to a soft pearlescent white underbelly.
visual_logic.environment: Crystal clear blue water of the Late Cretaceous shelf sea with long, horizontal underwater sunbeams cutting across the frame to establish a clear tracking line.
visual_logic.cinematic_effect: Strong 'caustic' light patterns dancing across the creature's back from the surface above, emphasizing its massive 12-to-15-meter length.

pose: A full-body horizontal profile view stretching completely from the left edge to the right edge of the frame. The massive body is aligned flat in the lower half of the image, keeping the top half clear so a second species can be drawn or stacked directly above it for side-by-side length comparison. The body is positioned horizontally without sharp twists, its flippers are kept compact, and its elongated snout points straight forward.
